supply.source: CHAIN conditional source study, 2026-11-12; tools/chain/supply-study.mjs; hashes in docs/chain/supply-study.json; not C2 telemetry

assumptions.implementation: All recipe variants are counterfactual. None is live or counted as an implemented sink. Current52-week and360 five-year controls remain separate.
assumptions.content: Two distinct bound cosmetic unlocks per season, finite8 or40 outputs over1 or5years. Ownership is retained; no expiry or repurchase of the same cosmetic. Content ends at the stated horizon.
assumptions.willingness: Persistent adoption10/50/100%; independently50% of adopting human accounts want each season catalog. This is an assumption, not measured retention. Bots have zero cosmetic utility.
assumptions.inputs: Two Epic units exactly. Sealed path irreversibly consumes2 sealed Epics; source path consumes2 authenticated unsealed Epics, avoiding an unnecessary20-YARN seal preparation. No power, XP or token rebate. Ordinary source authority remains unavailable.
assumptions.money: Universal20-YARN grant, unchanged deployed caps/fees/allocation, no growth or external buyers, conditional source supply. Market scenario price20 for all item tiers is a simplification, never a floor or forecast.
assumptions.thresholds: Original52-week claims/burn<=2 and farmer/hour<=3x casual remain required. Additional tests:75% casuals save2 by13;50% save10 by26; each last4 seasons has>=1 aggregate routine and burn. Savings exclude grants, resale and other spending; this is an upper affordability bound.
assumptions.health: Tail health>=1 burn/claim is reported separately; the weaker2x original acceptance is never equated with this health target. Tail casual median exposes tiny individual payouts.
assumptions.statistics: Three fresh scenario seeds per mix; sensitivity evidence only, not population inference or measured utility.
